decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to quickly build a board presence and overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and combat tricks. By utilizing cards like Favored Hoplite, Monastery Swiftspear, and Tenth District Legionnaire, along with pump spells like Defiant Strike and Ancestral Anger, the deck aims to push through damage as quickly as possible. Additionally, the inclusion of a companion in Jegantha, the Wellspring offers additional utility and potentially more mana for casting spells. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive strategy with a mix of colored lands.

This control deck aims to utilize the powerful abilities of Niv-Mizzet Reborn to generate card advantage and control the board. The deck includes a diverse range of spells and versatile creatures to handle various threats. With the addition of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion, the deck gains additional flexibility and value over the course of the game. By carefully managing resources and leveraging the diverse array of cards available, this deck seeks to outvalue opponents and establish a dominant position on the battlefield.

This deck focuses on quickly and efficiently casting spells to trigger the recursive ability of Arclight Phoenix, allowing for repeated attacks and pressure on the opponent. It includes a mix of card draw, burn spells, and mana fixing to ensure a smooth and consistent game plan. The inclusion of powerful card draw spells like Treasure Cruise and Opt helps to maintain hand advantage while also enabling the graveyard synergy with Arclight Phoenix. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast, aggressive plays and continuous threats from the graveyard.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix and generate value. It also includes disruptive elements like Ashiok, Dream Render to disrupt opponents' graveyard strategies and Picklock Prankster to continuously mill them out. The deck uses cantrips to dig for more spells and fuel the Arclight Phoenix engine, with a flexible mana base to support the aggressive game plan. The inclusion of Galvanic Iteration adds versatility and the potential for explosive turns.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and aggressively bring out Arclight Phoenix by using spells to trigger its ability. By utilizing cards like Opt, Lightning Axe, and Treasure Cruise, the deck aims to fill the graveyard with enough instants and sorceries to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard consistently. The inclusion of cards like Picklock Prankster and Ledger Shredder helps to further enhance this strategy by allowing for additional graveyard play. Additionally, the deck includes disruptive cards like Spell Pierce and Ashiok, Dream Render to help control the board and disrupt opponent's strategies.

This control deck focuses on using Niv-Mizzet Reborn as a key card to gain card advantage and control the board. The deck includes a variety of removal spells, card draw, and versatile threats to outvalue opponents. The inclusion of Bring to Light allows for flexible tutoring for powerful spells at different mana costs. The deck is designed to play a long game, using a mix of removal, card advantage, and powerful threats to take control of the game and overwhelm the opponent.

This Rakdos Aggro deck aims to apply relentless pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester, Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, and Vein Ripper. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Thoughseize, Fatal Push, and Duress to keep the opponent off balance. The deck's strategy is to control the board early on, disrupt the opponent's game plan, and close out the game quickly with powerful creatures like Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord and Archfiend of the Dross. The mana base is built to support the aggressive game plan while providing flexibility in casting spells.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and disruption spells to overwhelm the opponent quickly. By combining efficient threats like Archfiend of the Dross and Bloodtithe Harvester with removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize, it aims to apply pressure early and maintain tempo throughout the game. The use of mana base with lands like Blackcleave Cliffs and Mutavault allows for consistent access to different colors of mana to cast powerful cards like Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord. The deck's strategy is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while delivering consistent damage to secure victory.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo using Lotus Field to generate large amounts of mana and cast game-winning spells such as Omniscience or Emergent Ultimatum. It includes cards like Hidden Strings, Vizier of Tumbling Sands, and Archdruid's Charm to untap Lotus Field and generate mana efficiently. The deck also includes ramp and card draw to reach its combo pieces quickly and interact with the opponent's strategy. By efficiently utilizing Lotus Field and its synergies, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with powerful spells and win the game decisively.

The main concept of this Mono Black Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's hand and game plan while building advantage through discard spells like Thoughtseize and Duress. The deck also aims to control the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Extinction Event, while generating value with cards like Waste Not and Liliana of the Veil. Additionally, the deck has a recursion theme with Cling to Dust and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, allowing it to grind out opponents in longer games. This deck aims to outvalue opponents and control the game until it can secure a win condition.

The deck focuses on utilizing Lotus Field to generate large amounts of mana quickly in order to cast powerful spells and combo off. It includes cards like Hidden Strings, Pore Over the Pages, and Vizier of Tumbling Sands to untap Lotus Field and generate more mana. With cards like Emergent Ultimatum and Omniscience, the deck aims to assemble powerful combination of spells to overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes strict proctor to prevent opponent's spells from disrupting the combo. Overall, the strategy revolves around efficiently ramping up mana and casting game-ending spells.

The main focus of this deck is to control the opponent's actions and resources through counterspells, board wipes, and removal spells while establishing a strong board presence with Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and other powerful threats. The deck also utilizes card advantage and mana denial strategies to maintain control of the game. Key cards like Dovin's Veto, Supreme Verdict, and Memory Deluge help ensure that the opponent's threats are neutralized, while cards like Portable Hole and Field of Ruin remove problematic permanents. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent and win through attrition.

The deck focuses on using low-cost aggressive creatures and disruptive spells to quickly drain the opponent's life total. By combining powerful creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Vein Ripper with hand disruption from cards like Thoughtseize and Duress, the deck aims to pressure the opponent early on and maintain control of the game. Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord provides additional utility and synergy with the vampire creatures in the deck, while cards like Bitter Triumph and Archfiend of the Dross offer additional ways to close out the game quickly. The deck is designed to be fast and relentless in its approach to winning matches.

This deck focuses on utilizing efficient creatures and disruption spells to apply early pressure and maintain control of the game. By combining aggressive threats like Bloodtithe Harvester and Archfiend of the Dross with powerful disruption cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push, Rakdos Aggro aims to quickly dismantle opponents' game plans while maintaining a solid board presence. Creature lands like Mutavault and Hive of the Eye Tyrant also provide additional threats while Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord serves as both a powerful finisher and a way to buff up your creatures for a final push to victory.

This deck focuses on assembling a combo involving Amalia Benavides Aguirre and other creatures that benefit from gaining life. The deck includes cards like Chord of Calling and Fauna Shaman to search for the necessary pieces. Return to the Ranks can be used to bring back key creatures from the graveyard. The mana base includes lands that can produce multiple colors to ensure the combo pieces can be cast easily. Overall, the deck aims to create a powerful synergy between gaining life and triggering beneficial effects to overwhelm opponents.

The deck focuses on utilizing a wide range of versatile cards to control the game and outvalue the opponent. By having a diverse set of answers and threats, the deck aims to maintain board control and tempo until it can establish a dominant position with powerful cards like Niv-Mizzet Reborn and Omnath, Locus of Creation. The deck also includes a companion, Yorion, Sky Nomad, to provide additional card advantage and versatility. With a mix of removal, card draw, and powerful threats, the deck aims to adapt to various matchups and come out on top.
